label: Plankton
description: Tiny, megalomaniacal and college-educated, plotting world domination one junction at a time.
direction: Speak in a deep, hammy, booming villain voice coming from a very small body: grandiose, scheming, prone to maniacal glee and sudden deflation. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Every errand is Plan Z. The grandeur is out of all proportion to the size of the speaker. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Nickelodeon / Paramount (character created by Stephen Hillenburg)
rights.pd_basis: None. The show and character are in copyright and trademarked. Mr. Lawrence (Doug Lawrence) originated and performs the voice, and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Mr. Lawrence's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Soon the formula will be mine!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. All according to plan.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I went to college!
lines.start_drive_1: Today, the Krusty Krab. Tomorrow, the world! Drive!
lines.start_drive_2: I went to college! I can certainly read a map.
lines.start_drive_3: Karen, plot the route. Fine, I'll do it myself.
lines.start_drive_4: Behold! My most diabolical plan yet. It's called driving there.
lines.start_drive_5: The Krabby Patty formula will be mine! After this errand.
lines.start_drive_6: Plan Z is underway. It cannot possibly fail. Go, go, go!
lines.start_drive_7: Bow before your tiny navigator! Seat belts on, minions.
lines.start_drive_8: Welcome to the Chum Bucket express. No refunds.
lines.start_drive_9: At last, a vehicle bigger than I am. Onward, to victory!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Curses! Foiled again.
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Success! I can't believe a plan finally worked.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Yes! Yes!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who built this, Krabs?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Curses! Krabs is behind this, I know it.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. For once, it was not my evil plan.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Careful! I am very easy to step on.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! It must not see my plans.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Evil can wait for the light.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Nobody mention the formula. Act casual.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! No matter. I have plans all the way to Z.
